title: Night rerun: the six cad-3d cases gemma4:26b has not finished
goal: gemma4:26b has a graded result for every cad-3d case, so the cad-3d comparison with gemma4:12b (10/10) is complete
acceptance: In a night model plan on a quiet Mac (no owner use of the local model), from a development worktree at origin/main, never ~/.nerv-app: node tools/gauntlet.mjs model-run --profile=evals/gauntlet/profiles/gemma4-26b.json --pack=cad-3d --only=slicer-wall-layers-regression,tolerance-shrinkage-compensation-holdout,spacer-cylinder-regression,l-bracket-regression,open-tray-holdout,flanged-bushing-holdout --allow-models --execute --fresh --out=<new report>, then node tools/gauntlet.mjs ledger --report=<report> --pack=cad-3d
slicer-wall-layers-regression used the whole 2,048-token reply twice (evening 58 to 72 s, night 52 s); if it errors again it stops the run, so the other five run with --only without it
The result is added to docs/evaluations/2026-11-26-f126-t02-gemma4-26b-gauntlet.md and F-126
privacy: Local models only; no paid route, prompts are neutral fixtures, raw reports stay private on their base.
escalation: A model run needs a quiet Mac and the owner's night plan; a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: about 10 minutes of model time plus the ledger and report lines. Not a measurement.
